main.remarks: A lifetime binds to one host. Lifecycle notifications and disposal require the LifeKey returned by Bind.

field.name: StartingSource
field.summary: Cancellation source for the application starting notification.

field.name: StartedSource
field.summary: Cancellation source for the application started notification.

field.name: StoppingSource
field.summary: Cancellation source for the application stopping notification.

field.name: StoppedSource
field.summary: Cancellation source for the application stopped notification.

field.name: bound
field.summary: Indicates whether this lifetime has been bound.

property.name: LifeID
property.summary: Gets the current ID of the bound host.

property.name: ToolHost
property.summary: Gets the host bound to this lifetime.

method.name: Bind
method.summary: Binds this lifetime to one host and returns its opaque notification key.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Disposes lifetime resources when supplied with the owning host's key. Direct concurrent calls are not supported.
method.param: Key returned when the lifetime was bound.

method.name: TryBeginDispose
method.summary: Validates the owning host key and transitions the lifetime to disposed.
method.param: Key returned when the lifetime was bound.

method.name: DisposeLifetimeResources
method.summary: Provides derived lifetimes a hook to release resources after keyed disposal begins.

method.name: IsBoundTo
method.summary: Checks whether a notification or disposal key matches the current binding.
method.returns: True when the lifetime is bound and the key matches.

property.name: Logger
property.summary: Gets or sets the logger used for lifetime diagnostics.
